about: Medallion layer for every database table and view, blob container and job. tests/test_medallion_catalog.py fails when a migration adds a table or view, or Bicep adds a container, without an entry here. See docs/MEDALLION_ARCHITECTURE.md.

layers.bronze: Raw data exactly as received from IBKR, market-data providers and people's uploads. Append-only, never edited; corrections happen in silver.
layers.silver: Cleaned, validated and conformed records: accounts, securities, trades, positions, cash, NAV, FX, benchmark prices and derived portfolios. Each table's source says how it is rebuilt: ibkr tables from bronze (v2's own Flex pull from the switch on, v1.1's history from its archived statements), market-data tables once their raw responses are kept in bronze (S3b on), derived tables from other silver tables.
layers.gold: Reporting-ready analytics and frozen report payloads that feed the factsheets, decks, website and agents.
layers.ops: Control plane, not a data layer: runs, approvals, audit, access, onboarding workflow, agent state and configuration. Stays in public, including hand-maintained settings such as the subject and benchmark lists.
layers.platform: Database plumbing that stays in public: tenants, the migration ledger and the row-level-security helpers.

hops.quality-gate: Checks between layers; blocks promotion on failure.
hops.publish: Gold to rendered files and releases.
hops.serve: Gold and silver to the website and agents.

public.flex_rows.note: Every Flex record as raw JSON; the database copy of the raw statement. Every version stays in the raw statement files.
